## Content
This page was created for providing the code and dataset in order to reproduce the results of the paper cited below, aligned with the transparency principles. 

>Valença, G., Boani, B., Humberto, M., & Moura, F. _Examining perceptions of walkability among pedestrians at different times of the day_. Paper currently submitted for revision (2026).


* [Code](RaschModel_Final.R) for performing Rasch Models

* [Treated dataset from the survey](data.xlsx)
